label: Revenue growth (latest year)
why_this_band: Green = growing faster than about 5% a year; red = revenue fell

label: Profit margin (PBT)
why_this_band: Listed UK fund managers often report margins of 20-35%; below 10% leaves little room for a weak year

label: Operating margin
why_this_band: Same bands as PBT margin but excludes investment income and one-offs

label: Current ratio
why_this_band: Below 1.5x is worth a closer look at what sits in current assets and liabilities

label: Debt-to-equity
why_this_band: Up to 0.25x is light borrowing; above 0.5x means debt is a material share of funding

label: Interest coverage
why_this_band: Below 4x interest starts to take a large share of earnings

label: Equity change over 3 years
why_this_band: A fall of more than 10% means the capital base is shrinking
